SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT A.*, B.ORGID AS DEPARTMENTID, B.ORGNAME AS DEPARTMENTNAME, B.STATUS, B.PARENTORGID, C.ID USERORGID, C.ORGNAME, D.SAMPLEDEPARTMENT FROM T_EMC_EMP A LEFT JOIN T_CORE_USER B ON A.ID = B.ID LEFT JOIN T_CORE_ORG C ON B.PARENTORGID = C.ID LEFT JOIN T_CORE_ORG D ON B.ORGID = D.ID) T
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_CERT TAR_ WHERE TAR_.EMPID = T.ID AND TAR_.EXPIREDATE <= SYSDATE + TAR_.WARNINGDAYS )
AND ( "DEPARTMENTID" = #{departmentId_filter} OR DEPARTMENTID IN (SELECT id FROM T_CORE_ORG WHERE PARENTID =#{departmentId_filter}) )
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_CERT B LEFT JOIN T_EMC_CERT_TEST_METHOD C ON B.ID = C.CERTID WHERE T.ID = B.EMPID AND (T.FILTERTEST = '1' AND C.TESTID IN (${testids}) AND C.METHODID IN (${methodids}) AND (B.EXPIREDATE IS NULL OR B.EXPIREDATE > SYSDATE) OR T.FILTERTEST = '0' OR T.FILTERTEST IS NULL))
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_CORE_USER_PERMISSION F WHERE T.ID = F.USERID AND F.TARGETID = #{sampleOrgId})
AND T.ID != #{analysisUserId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_CORE_ORG F WHERE T.DEPARTMENTID = F.ID AND F.ORGNAME LIKE '分析%')
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_CORE_ORG F WHERE T.DEPARTMENTID = F.ID AND (F.ORGNAME = '检测部' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_CORE_ORG P WHERE F.PARENTID = P.ID AND P.ORGNAME = '检测部')))
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_CORE_USER_PERMISSION UP WHERE UP.PERMISSIONTYPEID = 'T_CORE_ORG' AND UP.TARGETID = T.ORGID AND UP.USERID = #{loginUser.id})
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_CORE_ROLE_USER R WHERE R.ROLEID = #{emc_role_assigned} AND R.USERID = T.ID)
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_EMP_QUAL R WHERE R.EXPIREDATE <= SYSDATE + R.WARNINGDAYS AND R.EMPID = T.ID)
ORDER BY
T.ID ASC
T.CREATEDTIME DESC, T.ID DESC
SELECT A.*, B.ORGNAME AS DEPARTMENTNAME, C.ORGNAME FROM T_EMC_EMP A LEFT JOIN T_CORE_USER B ON A.ID = B.ID LEFT JOIN T_CORE_ORG C ON B.PARENTORGID = C.ID WHERE A.ID = #{id}
